target: Filter Controller visual containment and width packing
objective: Verify that every filter type stays inside its assigned layout width across desktop and mobile states.
preconditions: A test page contains all Filter Controller filter types.
Each filter can be assigned layout widths of 25, 33, 50, and 100.
Range can be tested in horizontal and vertical orientations.
steps: Create a controller with all filter types at 100 width.
Test Range vertical with inputs, values, and ticks enabled.
Test long labels and long option values.
Check for page-level horizontal scroll and incoherent overlap.
expected_result: The controller packs filters predictably and no filter internals overflow their group or the page.
pass_criteria: No page-level horizontal overflow is present.
Range vertical does not push outside its grid span.
Long labels wrap or truncate by an intentional rule.
Mobile layout remains readable and full-width.
evidence_required: Guilherme QA notes for visual hierarchy
